issues.what: the corona reads as thin, stringy filaments with a mottled, textured disc; the target has broad radial ray spikes and a smoother, blown-out bloom that wraps over the planet's right limb
issues.fix: soften the filament detail and bring back the wide radial streaks and heavier bloom spilling toward the planet

issues.where: night hemisphere, left half of the disc (crops B, D, H)
issues.what: the dark side is a little more neutral and grainy, and the faint cool blue tint is gone (lower blue, about twice the pixel noise)
issues.fix: denoise the night side and push it slightly back toward the cool blue-black of the target

issues.where: starfield, lower left and right (crops D, E, I)
issues.what: the stars are denser, crisper and slightly brighter, so the sky looks busier than the target's softer field
issues.fix: reduce the star count or brightness slightly and soften the field to match

issues.what: the atmosphere glow at the limb is a bit thinner and sharper-edged than the target's warm haze
issues.fix: widen and soften the limb glow falloff a little

issues.where: foreground terrain and crater walls (crops D, G, H)
issues.what: fine surface detail and microcontrast are slightly softer (about 4% less local gradient), and the deepest shadows are slightly lifted
issues.fix: add back a little local contrast and sharpening, and lower the shadow floor slightly

issues.what: the starfield is slightly noisier and denser than the target's
issues.fix: denoise the sky slightly and match the star density
